description: France's Sirene register (INSEE) as a complete typed archive of legal persons: SIREN identity, legal form (catégorie juridique), NAF/APE activity, creation cohorts, headcount bands and head-office (siège) département, with derived analytics. Entrepreneurs individuels (sole traders) and non-diffusible units excluded by design. Dataset-only v1.
name: b12-france-sirene-register
